notes: find/replace are LF-normalised; the harness maps them to CRLF when the target file uses CRLF (Windows autocrlf checkouts).
Each find must occur exactly once in its file, otherwise the guard is MANIFEST_STALE; guards are never silently skipped.
A SURVIVED guard is a finding: no listed test fails when that guard is removed.
contracts/ is copied because deploy/app.py loads contracts/fashion-lineage.v1.json at import; without it the baseline is BASELINE_RED (measured).

Before pytest, each mutated module is imported in a fresh interpreter with the copy's import root on sys.path (deploy/szl_verticals/x.py -> szl_verticals.x). If the unmutated module imports cleanly but the mutant does not, the guard is MUTANT_INVALID, never KILLED.

KILLED requires pytest exit 1 and a test-level FAILED node id whose failure is not NameError/ImportError/ModuleNotFoundError/UnboundLocalError. Collection errors are MUTANT_INVALID; setup-only errors are UNPROVEN_ERROR.
Only git-tracked files of the copied dirs are copied (untracked files are listed in the receipt), so the baseline is the tracked tree, not another agent's scratch files.
